description:
LTX 2.3 Face Consistency Fix in ComfyUI — 10S Nodes Full Workflow Tutorial

WORKFLOW & Links - https://www.patreon.com/posts/ltx-2-3-face-fix-159823483?utm_medium=clipboard_copy&utm_source=copyLink&utm_campaign=postshare_creator&utm_content=join_link

LTX 2.3 has two problems that kill most workflows — face drift across frames and lip sync breaking the moment you run an upscale pass. In this video, I'm covering the 10S ComfyUI nodes that fix both of these at the architectural level, with no extra models required.

I'll walk you through the full workflow including the LTX Latent Anchor Aware node, LTX Latent Upsampler Tiled, and the LTX Tiled Sampler — plus a side-by-side comparison so you can see exactly what difference these nodes make in practice.


Full workflow demo at 720p using the GGUF version of LTX 2.3
Multi-action prompt test on an RTX 4090 — first try, no SageAttention

Honest take: LTX still isn't WAN 2.2 level on face consistency, but these nodes close the gap significantly.

#LTX23 #ComfyUI #AIVideo #FaceConsistency #LTXVideo #ComfyUIWorkflow #AIImageToVideo #10SNodes #LTXUpscale #IdentityPreservation #ComfyUITutorial #AIGirlie #OpenSource #AITools #VideoGeneration

Hi, thanks for sharing this workflow. I managed to run it successfully, and the face consistency / lip movement works really well.

I have one issue: when I make the character speak using text in the prompt, the video sometimes generates strange subtitles or random caption-like text on screen. I already tried adding negative prompts such as no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no text overlays, no transcript, but the artifacts still appear in some generations.

In your example videos, the talking characters do not show any subtitles. Did you use a specific setting, node, prompt format, model version, or workflow change to prevent subtitles/caption artifacts?

Also, do you recommend using short speech prompts instead of full dialogue text?
I also noticed that the workflow shown in the video includes an “LTX Face Attention Anchor” node, but the shared workflow I downloaded does not include that node. Is the video using a different or newer GGUF workflow than the shared JSON? Could you please clarify which workflow was used for the talking-character examples?

Thanks in advance.
